subject: MAP: Integration build plan - SDK, streaming, tool calling (draft)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan - SDK, streaming, tool calling (draft)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration milestone we discussed: SDK integration, streaming responses, tool calling, and structured outputs. High level summary below and a few open items we need you to confirm.

Key milestones (draft):
- M1: SDK integration (client libs + auth) — Owner: Acme (dev lead) / Redwood (integration PM) — Target: 2026-12-10
- M2: Streaming + prefix caching enablement — Owner: Redwood Eng (Marcus) — Target: 2026-12-15
- M3: Tool calling wiring (webhook + RPC) — Owner: Acme (platform eng) + Redwood Eng — Target: 2026-12-20
- M4: Structured outputs & schema validation (JSON schema + tests) — Owner: Acme QA / Redwood Solutions — Target: 2026-12-22
- M5: UAT and sign-off — Owner: Acme Product / Redwood CS — Target: 2026-12-28

Dependencies: API key provisioning, network egress rules (VPC setup), and a short SDK compatibility patch for your mobile app (we flagged a streaming buffer edge-case).

Open asks:
1) Please confirm internal owners for M1 and M3 (I put placeholders in the attached MAP).
2) Can you confirm the target close date window (we wrote mid-late Dec; would a 2026-12-28 sign-off work for procurement?)
3) Any additional compliance evidence you need early (SOC2 evidence, data residency notes)?

Attaching: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (milestones + owners sheet). I can update after you confirm owners.

Thanks — I can hop on another 30m if useful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan - SDK, streaming, tool calling (draft)

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. We're aligned on the milestones; a couple of notes from our side:

- M1 (SDK integration): Owner will be our Platform Eng lead, Priya Desai (cc'd). She'll assign an engineer; target OK for 2026-12-10 but needs confirmation after sprint planning on Monday.
- M3 (Tool calling): I'll own coordination but Priya's team will implement the webhook + RPC. We need a short spec for expected webhook payloads and auth flow.
- Streaming: Marcus, could you confirm whether the streaming API requires any client-side buffer changes for mobile clients? We saw the buffer edge-case Marissa mentioned.

Compliance: We'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short note on data retention (30/90/365-day options). Procurement ideally wants contracts signed by 2026-12-15 to meet budget cycles — can Redwood support that timeline if technical milestones land as planned?

I'll review the MAP spreadsheet later today and populate owner names.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Acme Robotics
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan - SDK, streaming, tool calling (draft)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — quick clarifications and updated owner assignments (I've also attached a lightweight integration architecture PNG to show networking/auth flow):

Updated owners & tasks (short):
- M1: SDK integration
  - Acme owner: Priya Desai (Platform Eng) — deliverable: mobile + server SDK quickstart, auth example (JWT)
  - Redwood owner: Marissa (PM) + Stephanie (Solutions Engineer) — deliverable: sample app + test harness
- M2: Streaming + prefix caching
  - Redwood owner: Marcus Lin (Eng) — action: enable streaming mode, validate mobile buffer handling, supply client-side guidance (snippets)
- M3: Tool calling (webhook)
  - Acme owner: Priya (impl) / Alex (product acceptance)
  - Redwood owner: Marcus + Stephanie — deliverable: webhook spec, retry/backoff guidance, example RPC mapping
- M4: Structured outputs & schema validation
  - Acme owner: QA lead (TBD) / Redwood owner: Solutions (Stephanie) — deliverable: JSON schemas + regression tests
- M5: UAT & sign-off
  - Joint owners: Acme Product (Alex) & Redwood CS (Marissa)

Dependencies (explicit):
- API key & environment prep (Redwood to provision staging keys) — ETA: 48 hours after contract LOA
- VPC egress rules & IP allowlist (Acme infra) — action item: Priya to provide firewall contacts and IPs to allowlist
- SDK compatibility patch for mobile streaming buffer — Marcus to validate and provide guidance by 2026-12-03

Procurement timeline: we can aim for contract sign-off by 2026-12-15 if tech milestones M1/M2 are on track. I'll loop Legal to expedite the SOW.

Next steps:
1) Priya: confirm M1 and M3 dev owners and firewall contact
2) Marcus: confirm streaming buffer note by 2026-12-03
3) Alex: confirm procurement target and whether SOC2 evidence can be provided to your procurement team (we have SOC2 docs and a short data retention explainer)

If helpful I can run a 30m technical handoff (Marcus + Priya + Stephanie) this week.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Internal: Next steps for Acme MAP (integration milestone)

Quick internal note to capture owners and our commitments to Acme:

- Marcus: please validate mobile streaming buffer edge-case and confirm whether a small client patch is needed. Deliverable: short doc + code snippet by 2026-12-03. Responsible: Marcus Lin.
- Stephanie: create sample SDK quickstart and test harness for Acme mobile team. Deliverable: sample app + README by 2026-12-08. Responsible: Stephanie Nguyen.
- Marissa (me): coordinate procurement/legal and update MAP spreadsheet after Priya confirms firewall contacts. Deliverable: updated MAP + contract LOA chase by 2026-12-06.

I'll schedule a 30m technical sync for this Thursday to align on webhook payload format and streaming guidance.

Thanks team — want to ensure we hit the procurement window and our target sign-off of 2026-12-28.

—Marissa
